verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents its own Identity Resolution product. It links related customer records into unified identities in the warehouse and resolves identities across devices and channels. Events (including identify calls) from browser and mobile SDKs feed into one resolved identity, and a Golden Record table uses survivorship rules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of anonymous-to-known stitching (e.g. anonymous ID merge on identify), detail on configurable matching/merge rules beyond survivorship, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
